definitions: A form of interior design where furnishings are either chosen for their appearance of age and signs of wear and tear or where new items are distressed to achieve the appearance of an antique.
A similar form of fashion in which clothing is made to appear aged or damaged.

blocks.text: Shabby chic is a style of interior design that chooses either furniture and furnishings for their appearance of age and signs of wear and tear or distresses new ones to achieve the same result. Unlike much genuine period décor, this style features a soft, pastel-colored, cottage look.
Chic, meaning "stylish" or "smart", is an element of fashion. It was originally a French word.

images.alt: A dresser with a distressed finish and mismatched drawer knobs, in Shabby chic style
